verbatim.method: exact text extracted from the session transcript

owner_decision_summary.dbf_1: freeze one specific current design for hall_icp_neutralizer today, before M2: intake, compressor, H1 geometry, magnetic target, ICP geometry, RF operating envelope, power allocation, mass policy / Xe reference load, thermal topology, primary / backup materials, reference host-drag model
owner_decision_summary.source_rule: only values or candidates already in the repository; no invented physics; where evidence is incomplete, freeze the selected engineering assumption with its evidence class and uncertainty instead of leaving the variable open

fixed_values.H1: RP-1: d_mean 70 mm, h 12 mm, L/h 8.6 (~103 mm length)
fixed_values.power: 1,350 W design allocation / 1,500 W RFP gate; 300 W common-load allocation
fixed_values.mass: 10 % system mass-margin policy; <= 34 kg nominal-dry target; 2 kg reference Xe load

owner_decision_summary.intake_compressor: select and freeze one baseline from existing registered candidates; if none closes both flow and drag, record a BASELINE_DEFICIENCY, not a reason to continue trading
owner_decision_summary.materials: select and freeze primary + backup Hall / ICP electrode materials from the existing candidate register
owner_decision_summary.host_drag: freeze a proposal / reference host-spacecraft drag geometry so M2 can calculate T-D, labelled reference pending customer ICD
owner_decision_summary.change_control: after DBF-1 no design value changes merely to improve M2 performance; any change needs a formal DCR identifying the physical / evidence reason before rerun

recorder_notes: A9.36 still applies: no Hall thrust values enter M2 while A6 remains STOP_NO_LEVEL_CONVERGED. M2 against DBF-1 evaluates all non-Hall paths at the frozen design; Hall thrust fields read HALL_NUMERICS_NOT_CONVERGED until a converged envelope from the A9.36 investigation exists. Supplying a converged Hall envelope later is an input completion, not a design change, and needs no DCR.
